title: REF-CHAT@v1 honest-refusal output (sprk_analysisaction.sprk_outputschemajson mirror)
description: Constrained-decoding contract for the tenant's no_match_handler refusal capability (FR-P2-04 / ADR-039 grounded-execution clause (d)). The single `refusal` string is the complete user-facing refusal message rendered verbatim by the agent-turn loop; RefusalCapabilityTool.ExtractRefusalText reads exactly this field from the stored ledger entry (render follows store, ADR-040).

refusal.description: The complete user-facing refusal message: acknowledges the request, states it is unavailable, lists what the assistant CAN do (the JPS-authored capability list only). One short paragraph.
